reviews.x: I use it for oven cleaning and removing burnt on grease. doesn't scratch the porcalin if used properly. the blade protector is a nice feature.  I would repeatedly lose the protective cap on other scrapers.

Wow! This works. We had tried all kinds of razors and blades to remove some serious burnt on messes. None but this worked. We were able to clean out 2 burners with serious stains in about 20 mins straight.

Not to bad,  while scrapping I didn't have the problem of accidentally depressing the blade lock like the old flat steel Stanley units, and it doesn't collect scrapings up into the blade pocket. I use these in a pretty aggressive manor such as scrapping old silicon off trailer roofs or old non-skid off trailer frames. I thought the small amount of blade exposure would be a problem but no. 4 Stars only because if your going to redesign this unit why no blade storage?? So I guess I am still keepin

Old razor blade scraper gave up the ghost so went to a home improvement store to purchase one but all they had was a small one for $4.44 so I purchased it because I needed one immediately. Decided to order one from Amazon because I wanted something a little more heavy duty. I paid $9.00 only to discover that it was very similar to the one I bought at the home improvement store. Designed a little differently but exactly the same size. I did get 10 extra blades with this one so I figure I paid $4.

The product was very easy to use. This is great for burnt on grease on the stove  A built in guard when not in use, easily changes the razors.  I had a different type from Home Depot that was hard to place blade in.  This one has replaceable blades that come with the product.

reviews.t: One of those tools you need more than you think
reviews.x: For years, I would simply just scrap off various residues with whatever I had on me: a knife blade, my finger nails, a flat head screw driver, a bare razor blade, etc. But after I needed to work on removing some sticky residue from a large pane of glass, I finally picked up a scraper. It's a simple tool, but it does the job well. The razor blade does most of the heavy lifting for these types of projects, but having a proper handle that safely locks into place is a dream and it makes the scraping

This is a great little gadget.  I had previously bought a seemingly similar item that was totally unusable.  I tried again and bought this one.  It’s perfect.  Well made, easy to use and priced very reasonably.  I used it to remove stickers on my windshield and it was super quick and efficient.  I’d highly recommend this to anyone.

I love this item. It works perfect for scraping the stickers off my windows. I like the fact it includes extra blades and has a red plastic cover to protect the installed blade. Easy change out. Definitely worth the money

reviews.t: Easy to use and clean. Great price
reviews.x: I use this to clean my glass stove top of some burned residue. I used to buy the single packs from a different brand from Publix earlier. This is so much better than those and much cheaper in price. Highly recommended

reviews.t: This works well on the glass in my oven door ...
reviews.x: This works well on the glass in my oven door and I expect it to work on my ceramic top as well.  Only problem is, how do you change the blades?
Awesome tool. Bought it to scrape/clean my glass top stove. Works perfectly.
Very handy.  Love this. It works perfect and is nice and sturdy
Very good at removing those difficult stuck on stains.

Was looking for replacement blades for my old scraper.  Replacement blades are sold in large quantities and ere pretty expensive so I purchased this replacement with extra blades.  the product is a great value and well worth the money!  solid construction, durable and they even include a little card with instructions and their contact info and where to go if you are not happy with the product.  wish all companies did this!

This scraper had a safety mechanism that comes up to cover the blade instead of bringing the blade down into the plastic part. I didn't think it mattered when I got my old one, but after a few uses, the blade would start to lower into the safety mechanism as soon as you put pressure on it. But this one always stays in place because it can't be raised or lowered. Definitely better.

I need to scrape some aluminum that bonded to the bottom of our built-in oven.  I tried a plastic scraper before it did nothing.  This tool was perfect for the job.  You're scraping with a single edge razor blade so you have to keep that in mind and be careful to hold it at a good angle so as not to gouge the service that scraping.  I'm very pleased with this purchase.

reviews.t: Perfect tool to clean glass stovetop
reviews.x: I bought this because I needed to clean my filthy, dirty glass stovetop. It had caked on debris even after trying all the tricks I could find. I used this scraper on the stovetop and it looks brand new! Hooray! It took about 20 minutes of focused scraping but this did the trick. Glass stovetop looks brand new and not a single scratch to account for.

I bought this item for my wife.  She was having trouble keeping our cook top looking good.  I asked around to see what others were using and was told that this little scraper tool was what was needed.  My wife used it, and she says that it is the bomb!  If you have a cook top stove, you really owe it to yourself to buy one of these guys.

I use this tool to clean our ceramic stove top.  So far, it does the job.......scraping burnt on residue off with ease.  I particularly like the way the blade is protected after use and how easy to slide the cover open when ready to use.  Haven't changed the blade yet but the instructions seem fairly clear for doing that.
I have cleaned many glass surfaces, windows, mirrors, glass table surfaces (albeit living room, dining room, bedroom, or even cars), and this product is a major easy fix with windex.
It's easy to handle and get a good angle for scraping glue off glass. It might be a bit small for a person with large, large hands. I'd buy another one, if needed.
I use this scraper for my glass top stove and also on my counter tops.  It works great and I like the protective shield it has when not in use.  Great product.
Does as described. I was finally able to clean la glass walls of my Phillips smokeless grill, and the door of my oven. Great price too.
Great little tool. Had excess caulking around the edges after installing a window. This little baby scraped it all off in no time.

reviews.t: Removes the gunk on glass stove.
reviews.x: The build quality is solid. I like how they provide multiple blades with it. Easy to use. Ergonomic shape.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the scraper works well for removing burnt-on grease and residue from stovetops and oven glass.
Many reviewers praise the value, noting it is well made, sturdy, and reasonably priced, often including extra blades.
Several reviewers highlight the blade protector/guard as a useful safety feature that prevents blade slipping.
A few reviewers mention difficulty or confusion about changing the blades.
Some reviewers note the protective cap is easy to lose.
